label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Marketing jargon got you stuck? Get clarity!
body: Get 102 essential internet marketing terms, explained simply from A to Z, in this free, practical guide for creators and sellers.
caption: Ever feel lost in the sea of marketing terms? 🤯 SEO, PPC, organic, lead magnet – it can be a lot! We put together this free guide, 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary,' to cut through the confusion. It explains 102 common terms in plain English, A to Z, so you can understand what's what and move forward with confidence. Grab your free copy today!
